notes.content:

notes.title: Booty Diver Officially releases 9/20/17
notes.content:
Hello there folks,

This Jason of Xavier Orion Games ,and I'm proud to announce that after originally being announced clear back in 2015 Booty Diver is finally finding it's way to Steam.

The game will be $4.99 with a 25% off discount at launch when it releases on 9/20/17.

We're proud to have our first project has not only found a home on consoles ,but also on Steam. With that we hope you enjoy our unique take on a retro style arcade action game.

Thank you all for your support ,and interest in Booty Diver as well as our upcoming games.
